info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Proofs-v2-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to retrieve documented proofs associated with logistics shipments, enhancing transparency and traceability. It serves as a crucial resource for logistics managers and compliance officers who require access to shipment verification documents. The functionality includes accessing a list of proofs, facilitating due diligence, auditing, and reporting processes. Typical use cases include validating shipment records and ensuring adherence to regulations within supply chain operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve proof documents related to specific shipments. It is useful for verifying shipment status and ensuring that all necessary documentation is complete.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving proof of shipments. This body structure specifies the necessary parameters required for the shipment proof query.

ListLogisticsShipmentsProofsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for obtaining shipment proof operations in JSON format.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the shipment.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsProofsResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response for the GET operation on shipments proof. It contains the status and details related to the shipment request.

createdBy.description: The user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit information related to the shipment operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the processing of the request took on the server. This value helps in measuring the performance of the API endpoint.
